propositions: Code review currently lacks a concurrency rubric to detect data races; existing overlays cover only TOCTOU (security) and load-shaped concurrency (performance), leaving unlocked accesses unowned.

The modal unlocked-twin race class in this repo (whole-index writes via git rm+commit, and index.lock reclaim via getmtime-then-remove) is not detected by deterministic lexical triggers that require explicit synchronization primitives.

A two-tier deterministic lexical trigger is needed: a committed high-precision tier (firing only on explicit lock tokens, portable and low-noise) and a project-extensible noisy tier (in criteria_routing.json, catching repo-specific modal races).

The concurrency overlay must fire via diff content analysis (added and removed lines bearing synchronization tokens) and integrate with Pass-1 reviewer escalation and the base catalog without model-emitted severity.
Built-in overlays must support project-level extension of trigger_tokens and applies_to globs through configuration without code changes.
The overlay ships advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) and deliberately does not cover no-twin races and CI-level CAS/backoff judgment.
